question: Why is the reality of willing, knowing, and acting worthy of worship?
premises: The worshippable reality consists of willing, knowing, and acting.
All directions of limitation are gathered within it.
inference: Because it is unbounded and contains all possible limitations, the triad of willing, knowing, and acting is supremely worshippable.
plain_english: This worshippable reality, consisting of willing, knowing, and acting, is worthy of worship because it is unlimited; even all directions of limitation are gathered within it.
